focus: 以雙庫水量與能量守恆建立可追溯的抽蓄水位排程~Build traceable pumped-storage schedules using paired-reservoir water and energy balances

units.anchor: 雙庫水量帳本~Paired reservoir water balance
units.title: 雙庫水量帳本~Paired reservoir water balance
units.mechanism: 抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。每個時間步都應同時更新兩庫，明確約定流量正方向；只看上庫水位容易掩蓋下庫已滿或總水量不守恆的排程錯誤。 假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。~Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms. Update both reservoirs at every interval with explicit flow signs. Tracking only the upper level can hide a full lower reservoir or a schedule that violates total water conservation. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.
units.verify: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。~Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds.
units.practice: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。~Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds.
units.failure: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。日終總量碰巧正確也不能證明中途下庫未經溢流或超界。~Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. A correct daily total does not prove that intermediate lower-reservoir storage avoided overflow or other boundary violations.
units.misconception: 只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。~A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.

units.anchor: 水位庫容換算~Level and storage conversion
units.title: 水位庫容換算~Level and storage conversion
units.mechanism: 水位不是可直接加減的能量刻度，必須透過測得的庫容曲線換成水量。局部面積不變只適合小範圍近似，廣大的淺灘或陡岸會改變同一水量對應的水位變化；上下庫曲線也不能混用，即使它們具有相近的最大面積。 假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。~Water level is not an additive energy scale; surveyed storage curves connect level to volume. A constant surface area is a local approximation, and broad shelves or steep banks change the level response to equal transfers. Upper and lower curves are not interchangeable merely because their maximum surface areas appear similar. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve.
units.verify: 將水位、庫容及面積資料用共同高程基準整理，檢查曲線斜率是否等於水面面積。以已知移水量回算兩庫水位並比較實測殘差，遇到灘地轉折時縮短時間步或直接用曲線求解。~Put level, storage and area on a common datum and check that storage-curve slope equals surface area. Back-calculate levels from known transfers, inspect measured residuals and resolve shoreline breaks with smaller steps or direct curve inversion.
units.practice: 將水位、庫容及面積資料用共同高程基準整理，檢查曲線斜率是否等於水面面積。以已知移水量回算兩庫水位並比較實測殘差，遇到灘地轉折時縮短時間步或直接用曲線求解。~Put level, storage and area on a common datum and check that storage-curve slope equals surface area. Back-calculate levels from known transfers, inspect measured residuals and resolve shoreline breaks with smaller steps or direct curve inversion.
units.failure: 將平方公里當成平方米會使水位變化嚴重失真，沿用過期地形也會錯估可用容積。感測器高程基準偏移時，曲線再精細也不能修復錯誤輸入。~Confusing square kilometers with square meters grossly distorts level change, and outdated bathymetry misstates usable storage. A detailed curve cannot correct a sensor referenced to the wrong elevation datum.
units.misconception: 同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。~The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs.

units.anchor: 毛水頭與淨水頭~Gross and net head
units.title: 毛水頭與淨水頭~Gross and net head
units.mechanism: 上下游水面高差是毛水頭，機組可利用的淨水頭還受沿程與局部損失影響，且損失隨流量及模式改變。把泵送和發電套同一個帶符號的效率可能混淆能量方向；先畫能量線，才能知道損失在哪一側增加需求或減少輸出。 假設上庫600m、下庫200m、發電水頭損失15m，淨水頭H=600−200−15=385m；未代表其他流量的損失。~The reservoir-level difference is gross head, while usable turbine head also depends on distributed and local losses that vary with flow and mode. Applying one signed efficiency to both pumping and generation obscures energy direction. An energy-grade sketch identifies where losses increase pumping demand or reduce generating output for the chosen operating point. Assume upper elevation600m, lower200m and generation loss15m. Net headH=600−200−15=385m, without prescribing losses at other discharges.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫600m、下庫200m、發電水頭損失15m，淨水頭H=600−200−15=385m；未代表其他流量的損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper elevation600m, lower200m and generation loss15m. Net headH=600−200−15=385m, without prescribing losses at other discharges.
units.verify: 用同時刻的上下庫水位建立毛水頭，逐項標註流道損失與量測位置。核對泵送時損失應加到所需揚程，發電時則扣除，並以不同流量資料檢查固定損失假設的適用範圍。~Calculate gross head from simultaneous levels and label each loss and measurement location. Verify that pumping adds losses to required lift while generation subtracts them, then use different flow observations to test the limited range of a constant-loss approximation.
units.practice: 用同時刻的上下庫水位建立毛水頭，逐項標註流道損失與量測位置。核對泵送時損失應加到所需揚程，發電時則扣除，並以不同流量資料檢查固定損失假設的適用範圍。~Calculate gross head from simultaneous levels and label each loss and measurement location. Verify that pumping adds losses to required lift while generation subtracts them, then use different flow observations to test the limited range of a constant-loss approximation.
units.failure: 水位資料時間不一致會創造不存在的水頭，將損失重複扣除會低估輸出。忽略低水位進水條件與空化限制，也可能讓數學上可行的排程超出機組適用範圍。~Unsynchronized levels create a fictitious head, and double-counted losses understate output. Neglecting low-level intake and cavitation constraints can also place an arithmetically feasible schedule outside the machine’s permitted operating envelope.
units.misconception: 毛水頭與機組淨水頭在所有流量下都完全相等。~Gross reservoir head and machine net head are equal at every discharge.

units.anchor: 發電功率與輸出~Generating power and output
units.title: 發電功率與輸出~Generating power and output
units.mechanism: 水力功率由流量與淨水頭共同決定，電輸出還要乘適用工況的總效率。額定容量只是設備界限而不是每一時刻都能供應的功率；水位下降、效率曲線或流道限制會改變結果，排程應保存每步輸入而非只指定固定兆瓦數。 假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。~Hydraulic power depends jointly on discharge and net head, with electrical output reduced by the efficiency appropriate to that condition. Nameplate capacity is an equipment bound rather than power available at every instant. Changing level, efficiency curves and waterway limits require stored stepwise inputs instead of simply assigning a constant megawatt output. Assume density1000kg/m³, discharge100m³/s, net head385m and overall generating efficiency0.90. P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW at this stated operating point.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume density1000kg/m³, discharge100m³/s, net head385m and overall generating efficiency0.90. P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW at this stated operating point.
units.verify: 分清機械、發電機與總效率的定義，避免把同一損失計算兩遍。以每步流量和淨水頭算功率，積分成電能後對照電表，同時保留啟停、輔機與不可運轉區域的獨立紀錄。~Distinguish mechanical, generator and overall efficiency to avoid duplicated losses. Compute each step’s power from discharge and net head, integrate to energy and compare with meters while separately retaining starts, auxiliary loads and prohibited operating regions.
units.practice: 分清機械、發電機與總效率的定義，避免把同一損失計算兩遍。以每步流量和淨水頭算功率，積分成電能後對照電表，同時保留啟停、輔機與不可運轉區域的獨立紀錄。~Distinguish mechanical, generator and overall efficiency to avoid duplicated losses. Compute each step’s power from discharge and net head, integrate to energy and compare with meters while separately retaining starts, auxiliary loads and prohibited operating regions.
units.failure: 將百分之九十直接代成九十會放大百倍，忽略功率與電能的時間轉換則使排程帳本失衡。用額定效率覆蓋全部負載，也可能系統性高估低負載輸出。~Entering ninety instead of0.90 inflates output a hundredfold, while omitting the time conversion confuses power and energy. Extending rated efficiency to every load can systematically overstate output away from the reference condition.
units.misconception: 額定發電容量足夠就保證任意水位都能連續輸出相同功率。~Adequate nameplate capacity guarantees identical continuous output at any reservoir level.

units.anchor: 抽水輸入與損失~Pumping input and losses
units.title: 抽水輸入與損失~Pumping input and losses
units.mechanism: 抽水必須提供提升水體與克服損失所需的能量，因此電輸入除以效率而不是乘以效率。泵的穩定運轉範圍、可變速能力及轉換時間會影響流量是否可調；能源帳本可比較方案，但不能把連續公式直接當成每座固定轉速機組的控制命令。 假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。~Pumping input must cover both elevation gain and hydraulic losses, so electrical demand divides by efficiency rather than multiplying it. Stable pump range, speed flexibility and mode-transition time determine whether discharge can actually be varied. An energy ledger can compare options without turning a continuous formula into an operating command for every fixed-speed unit. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries.
units.verify: 在同一能量邊界記錄泵輸入與水體得到的能量，標註效率是否已含馬達及變頻設備。檢查機組曲線與模式切換時段，將不可行的中間流量排除，再用電表積分核對假設效率。~Record pump input and water-energy gain across the same boundary, noting whether motor and converter losses are included. Check machine curves and mode transitions, exclude infeasible intermediate flows and compare metered energy with the assumed aggregate efficiency.
units.practice: 在同一能量邊界記錄泵輸入與水體得到的能量，標註效率是否已含馬達及變頻設備。檢查機組曲線與模式切換時段，將不可行的中間流量排除，再用電表積分核對假設效率。~Record pump input and water-energy gain across the same boundary, noting whether motor and converter losses are included. Check machine curves and mode transitions, exclude infeasible intermediate flows and compare metered energy with the assumed aggregate efficiency.
units.failure: 將效率相乘會得到比水力需求還小的電輸入，違反能量守恆。若輔機已含在總效率又再扣一次，亦會錯估整個循環的損失與可回收電量。~Multiplying by efficiency produces electrical input below the water-energy requirement and violates conservation. Counting auxiliaries both within aggregate efficiency and separately also misstates cycle loss and recoverable electrical output.
units.misconception: 抽水效率越低時用電需求反而應該越小。~Lower pumping efficiency should reduce the electrical input required for the same lift and flow.

units.anchor: 往返效率的邊界~Round-trip efficiency boundaries
units.title: 往返效率的邊界~Round-trip efficiency boundaries
units.mechanism: 往返效率應以完整且一致的週期比較輸入與輸出，起終庫存不同時不能把借用的水能誤當效率提升。定水頭理想化下兩個方向效率相乘很方便，但水頭損失和輔機仍要說明；不同計量邊界的結果不可直接排名優劣。 假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。~Round-trip efficiency compares input and output over a complete cycle with consistent boundaries. Different terminal storage can make borrowed water energy look like improved efficiency. Multiplying directional efficiencies is convenient under equal constant head, but hydraulic loss and auxiliaries must be stated, and values measured across different boundaries should not be ranked as equivalent. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%.
units.verify: 列出週期起終兩庫水位、輸入電能與輸出電能，校正外來水量造成的能量改變。註明是否計入待機及變壓器損失，只有邊界相同時才比較往返效率，並保留原始電表時間區間。~List initial and final levels in both reservoirs and metered input and output, correcting for energy introduced by external water. State treatment of standby and transformer losses and compare round-trip figures only across matching boundaries and time intervals.
units.practice: 列出週期起終兩庫水位、輸入電能與輸出電能，校正外來水量造成的能量改變。註明是否計入待機及變壓器損失，只有邊界相同時才比較往返效率，並保留原始電表時間區間。~List initial and final levels in both reservoirs and metered input and output, correcting for energy introduced by external water. State treatment of standby and transformer losses and compare round-trip figures only across matching boundaries and time intervals.
units.failure: 若日終上庫比起初低，額外發電可能只是消耗庫存。把這部分輸出除以當日抽水電量會出現虛高甚至超過百分之百的結果，卻不是無損儲能。~Ending with a lower upper reservoir can add generation by consuming inventory. Dividing that output by only the day’s pumping input yields inflated or even above-unity efficiency without demonstrating lossless storage.
units.misconception: 只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。~Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent.

units.anchor: 可用水量與時數~Usable volume and duration
units.title: 可用水量與時數~Usable volume and duration
units.mechanism: 儲能時數受可移動水量及可接受流量共同限制，不等同於水庫總容積除以任意大流量。死水位、下庫空間、最低淹沒深度和保留需求會縮小可用範圍；長時間輸出還會改變水頭，所以等流量時數只提供第一層水量檢核。 假設已扣保留量的可移水量720000m³、定流量100m³/s，t=720000/100=7200s即2h；不保證定功率兩小時。~Storage duration is limited by transferable water and feasible discharge, not total reservoir volume divided by any desired flow. Dead storage, lower-reservoir room, intake submergence and reserved water reduce the usable range. Head changes during a long release, so constant-discharge duration provides only the first water-balance check rather than constant-power endurance. Assume transferable volume720000m³ after reservations and constant discharge100m³/s. Duration7200s equals2h, without guaranteeing constant electrical power throughout.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設已扣保留量的可移水量720000m³、定流量100m³/s，t=720000/100=7200s即2h；不保證定功率兩小時。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume transferable volume720000m³ after reservations and constant discharge100m³/s. Duration7200s equals2h, without guaranteeing constant electrical power throughout.
units.verify: 從上下庫限制交集求可移水量，逐項列出死庫容與保留用途，避免直接用最大庫容。沿兩小時路徑更新水頭和效率，檢查下庫、進水淹沒及機組界限，最後才給出可交付電能。~Derive transferable volume from the intersection of both reservoirs’ constraints, explicitly subtracting dead storage and reservations. Update head and efficiency along the two-hour path, checking lower storage, intake submergence and machine limits before reporting deliverable energy.
units.practice: 從上下庫限制交集求可移水量，逐項列出死庫容與保留用途，避免直接用最大庫容。沿兩小時路徑更新水頭和效率，檢查下庫、進水淹沒及機組界限，最後才給出可交付電能。~Derive transferable volume from the intersection of both reservoirs’ constraints, explicitly subtracting dead storage and reservations. Update head and efficiency along the two-hour path, checking lower storage, intake submergence and machine limits before reporting deliverable energy.
units.failure: 上庫仍有水不代表下庫還有接收空間，最低進水淹沒也可能先被觸及。將定流量的時數宣稱為額定功率時數，會忽略逐步減少的水頭及效率變動。~Water remaining upstream does not imply space downstream, and minimum intake submergence may bind first. Reporting constant-flow duration as rated-power endurance ignores falling head and changing efficiency during release.
units.misconception: 只要上庫尚未排空就可以維持額定功率直到最後一滴水。~Rated power can be maintained until the upper reservoir is completely empty.

units.anchor: 爬坡流量積分~Integrating flow ramps
units.title: 爬坡流量積分~Integrating flow ramps
units.mechanism: 排程時間步內的流量若持續變化，採末端值代表整段會錯估移水量。線性爬坡可用梯形積分，但真實閥門和機組反應未必線性；較慢的水量排程也不能取代水錘檢查，因為相同總移水量可能對應完全不同的瞬態壓力。 假設流量在300s內由0線性升至100m³/s，V=(0+100)×300/2=15000m³；此為水量積分而非水錘驗算。~A changing discharge should not be represented by its final value over the whole interval. A linear ramp permits trapezoidal integration, although real actuators and machines may respond nonlinearly. Slow scheduling calculations do not replace water-hammer checks because equal transferred volume can arise from very different pressure-transient histories in the waterway. Assume discharge rises linearly from0 to100m³/s in300s. Transferred V=15000m³ by trapezoidal integration, not a water-hammer assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設流量在300s內由0線性升至100m³/s，V=(0+100)×300/2=15000m³；此為水量積分而非水錘驗算。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume discharge rises linearly from0 to100m³/s in300s. Transferred V=15000m³ by trapezoidal integration, not a water-hammer assessment.
units.verify: 保留流量歷時並檢查爬坡形狀，將梯形積分與較短時間步積分比較。另把閥位、轉速及壓力歷時送到瞬態分析，清楚標註此水量帳本沒有證明閥門速度或壓力變化可被接受。~Retain the discharge history, check ramp shape and compare trapezoidal integration with smaller time steps. Examine valve, speed and pressure histories in a separate transient analysis, explicitly recording that the volume ledger does not approve actuator rates or pressure excursions.
units.practice: 保留流量歷時並檢查爬坡形狀，將梯形積分與較短時間步積分比較。另把閥位、轉速及壓力歷時送到瞬態分析，清楚標註此水量帳本沒有證明閥門速度或壓力變化可被接受。~Retain the discharge history, check ramp shape and compare trapezoidal integration with smaller time steps. Examine valve, speed and pressure histories in a separate transient analysis, explicitly recording that the volume ledger does not approve actuator rates or pressure excursions.
units.failure: 以末端一百立方米每秒乘全段會把移水量加倍，造成下一時段庫位預測偏移。即使水量積分正確，短暫快速動作仍可能產生排程模型看不到的壓力波。~Using the final discharge over the full interval doubles this transferred volume and biases the next storage estimate. Correct integration still cannot reveal short rapid actions that generate pressure waves outside the scheduling model.
units.misconception: 爬坡期間總水量正確就能證明任何閥門動作都不會產生水錘。~A correct total ramp volume proves that every associated valve movement is free of water hammer.

units.anchor: 外部水量與封閉循環~External water and closed loops
units.title: 外部水量與封閉循環~External water and closed loops
units.mechanism: 封閉循環表示缺乏持續天然水體連通，並不代表沒有降雨、蒸發、滲漏或補水。這些小流量累積後會改變長期可用庫存，兩庫表面積不同又會造成不對稱損失；調度帳本要分清天氣水量與機組搬移，才能找到真實偏差來源。 假設兩庫合計水面1000000m²、日蒸發0.004m，日損失4000m³；未計降雨與滲漏，不可稱封閉循環零耗水。~A closed loop lacks an ongoing natural-water connection, but rainfall, evaporation, seepage and makeup water still matter. Small persistent fluxes alter long-term inventory, and different reservoir areas produce unequal losses. Separating weather exchange from machine transfers allows the scheduling ledger to diagnose the actual source of a storage discrepancy rather than assign every change to pumping. Assume combined surface area1000000m² and daily evaporation0.004m. Loss is4000m³/day, excluding rain and seepage; closed-loop does not mean zero water use.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩庫合計水面1000000m²、日蒸發0.004m，日損失4000m³；未計降雨與滲漏，不可稱封閉循環零耗水。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume combined surface area1000000m² and daily evaporation0.004m. Loss is4000m³/day, excluding rain and seepage; closed-loop does not mean zero water use.
units.verify: 將降雨蒸發深度乘當日水面積，核對毫米與米及每日與每秒的換算。把滲漏、補水與量測零漂分開追蹤，以多日總量閉合而非單一水位點判斷是否存在持續庫存損失。~Multiply weather depths by contemporaneous surface area and verify millimeter-to-meter and daily-to-second conversions. Track seepage, makeup and sensor drift separately, using multi-day volume closure rather than one level reading to identify persistent inventory loss.
units.practice: 將降雨蒸發深度乘當日水面積，核對毫米與米及每日與每秒的換算。把滲漏、補水與量測零漂分開追蹤，以多日總量閉合而非單一水位點判斷是否存在持續庫存損失。~Multiply weather depths by contemporaneous surface area and verify millimeter-to-meter and daily-to-second conversions. Track seepage, makeup and sensor drift separately, using multi-day volume closure rather than one level reading to identify persistent inventory loss.
units.failure: 將蒸發列成每次抽水循環的固定損失會讓結果隨排程次數虛增，忽略面積變化又會產生季節偏差。漏水與零漂混在一起時，錯誤補水判斷也可能擴大。~Treating evaporation as a fixed loss per pumping cycle makes it grow artificially with cycling frequency. Ignoring area variation adds seasonal bias, while confusing leakage with sensor drift can lead to inappropriate makeup estimates.
units.misconception: 封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。~Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage.

units.anchor: 期末庫存與預留~Terminal inventory and reservation
units.title: 期末庫存與預留~Terminal inventory and reservation
units.mechanism: 有限時域排程若不約束期末庫存，會把最後一刻耗盡上庫當成最佳結果，卻把下一日需求隱藏起來。預留可用水量與電能不能直接互換，必須考慮當時水頭和可用機組；應明列預留目的以及何時可以釋放，避免重複承諾同一份水。 假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。~A finite-horizon schedule without a terminal-storage constraint can favor emptying the upper reservoir at the last instant while hiding the following day’s need. Reserved water is not automatically reserved electrical energy because head and unit availability matter. State the purpose and release condition of each reservation to avoid committing the same inventory to multiple services. Assume upper usable storage800000m³ with200000m³ reserved. At most600000m³ is transferable if other constraints permit, without double-allocating the reservation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper usable storage800000m³ with200000m³ reserved. At most600000m³ is transferable if other constraints permit, without double-allocating the reservation.
units.verify: 把期末目標、預留用途與可釋放條件寫成獨立約束，逐步檢查同一水量是否被重複計入不同服務。將預報入流減少的情境再跑一次，報告未滿足需求而非讓計算暗中借用下一日庫存。~Express terminal targets, reserved services and release conditions as separate constraints and check inventory is not allocated twice. Repeat the schedule with reduced forecast inflow and report unmet demand rather than silently borrowing storage intended for the next day.
units.practice: 把期末目標、預留用途與可釋放條件寫成獨立約束，逐步檢查同一水量是否被重複計入不同服務。將預報入流減少的情境再跑一次，報告未滿足需求而非讓計算暗中借用下一日庫存。~Express terminal targets, reserved services and release conditions as separate constraints and check inventory is not allocated twice. Repeat the schedule with reduced forecast inflow and report unmet demand rather than silently borrowing storage intended for the next day.
units.failure: 完美預報假設會讓預留不足的方案看似可行，期末缺水又會被截斷時域隱藏。若兩個備援服務同時到來，共用一份預留水量的承諾便無法全部履行。~Perfect-forecast assumptions can make inadequate reserves seem feasible, while horizon truncation hides terminal shortage. If two reserve services arrive together, promises backed by the same water inventory cannot both be fulfilled.
units.misconception: 同一份預留水量可以同時保證任意多個獨立備援服務。~The same reserved water can simultaneously guarantee any number of independent backup services.

title: 抽蓄水庫水位調度~Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage
summary: 本課從上下庫逐時水量守恆開始，將庫容、水位、淨水頭、機組效率與電能連成可追溯帳本。十個單元分別處理抽水與發電方向、往返效率、可用時數、爬坡積分、天氣損失和期末預留，要求學徒在每個時間步查兩庫限制，並把慢速排程與快速水錘模型分開驗證。~Starting with paired-reservoir conservation, this course connects storage, level, net head, machine efficiency and energy in a traceable ledger. Ten units distinguish pumping and generation, cycle efficiency, duration, ramps, weather exchange and terminal reserves. Apprentices check both reservoirs at every step and verify slow scheduling separately from rapid waterway transients.
history: 抽蓄的核心是先用電把水提升，再於需要時讓水回流發電，並非生產額外能量。巴斯郡業主記錄電站於一九八五年十二月商轉，墾務局埃爾伯特資料提供另一組真實抽蓄配置。本課不把兩站的營運參數混成通用模板。美國陸軍工兵團二〇〇八年更新水力電廠結構手冊；能源部二〇二二年的介紹則記錄國家實驗室指南及二〇二一年工具發布，提醒分析服務、時間邊界和權衡。下列數值全為獨立教學假設，不是任一電站的調度表。~Pumped storage first uses electricity to lift water and later recovers part of that energy; it does not create additional energy. The Bath County owner records commercial operation in December1985, while Reclamation’s Mt. Elbert data supplies another genuine configuration. Their operating parameters are not blended into a universal template. USACE updated hydroelectric structural guidance in2008, and DOE’s2022 article describes laboratory valuation guidance and the tool released in2021, emphasizing services, boundaries and tradeoffs. Every numerical example below is an independent teaching assumption rather than a plant schedule.
example: 原創水頭敏感度：固定流量100m³/s、總發電效率0.90與密度1000kg/m³，淨水頭385m時功率為339.9165MW。如果其他假設維持不變而淨水頭提高10%至423.5m，功率為373.90815MW，正好提高10%。這不表示真實機組可突破額定容量，也不表示水頭提高後效率必然固定。學徒應把新工況放回效率曲線、流量與電氣容量限制，再沿上下庫水位歷時積分電能。若要求固定功率，流量會反向調整，不能仍用原先水量帳本，且需重新檢查管路瞬態與進水條件。~Original head sensitivity: with discharge100m³/s, overall generating efficiency0.90 and density1000kg/m³ fixed, net head385m gives339.9165MW. Raising net head by10% to423.5m while holding the other assumptions fixed gives373.90815MW, exactly10% higher. This does not permit exceeding nameplate capacity or establish constant real-machine efficiency at the new head. Place the new condition on the efficiency map and check discharge and electrical limits before integrating energy along the reservoir-level histories. If constant power is required instead, discharge changes inversely; the original water ledger no longer applies and transient and intake conditions must be checked again.
facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫600m、下庫200m、發電水頭損失15m，淨水頭H=600−200−15=385m；未代表其他流量的損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper elevation600m, lower200m and generation loss15m. Net headH=600−200−15=385m, without prescribing losses at other discharges.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume density1000kg/m³, discharge100m³/s, net head385m and overall generating efficiency0.90. P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW at this stated operating point.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%.
